Data packs, wey dey use most of the storage space, dey go inside cold storage.
messages.ui.protect.coldGuidance2: If you set bucket lifecycle rules for your provider, we strongly recommend make you turn those rules off so dem no go move metadata to cold storage by mistake. Backups go break if metadata enter cold storage.
messages.ui.protect.coldGuidance3: Every cold storage provider get im own costs for access, retrieval, and deletion of data for cold storage. Replicaro dey turn off data integrity checks for all cold storage vaults so you no go incur excessive costs. Use hot storage if you need data integrity checks. The setting to free up space go remain for the default "every day"; if you wan turn off work to free up space, set am to "start am yourself" from Advanced settings below.
